title: Align Tree Action Buttons to Value Column Right Edge
prompt: In the sketchpad details panel, TreeSection and TreeItem add/remove action buttons (AddIcon/RemoveIcon) need to sit flush with the right edge of the property value field column (160px wide). Currently they are placed inside the label content area of TreeAlignedRow and drift/misalign across nested groups. The fix should be generic for all collection nodes in the right-side property inspector.
summary: In elements/ui/index.tsx, refactored TreeSection, TreeItem (default layout), and SortableTreeItem to place action buttons (AddIcon/RemoveIcon) in a dedicated right column aligned with the 160px value column when isTree=true. When isTree=true and actions.length>0, the row container becomes a CSS grid with gridTemplateColumns: minmax(0,1fr) 160px, and actions are rendered in the right column outside TreeAlignedRow. Added 3 new tests. All 17 tests pass.
